text.tspan: kube-scheduler: filter → score → bind (it only decides)
• a taint the pod doesn't tolerate
Filter uses requests, not real usage. Scheduler down → new pods Pending with NO FailedScheduling events.
HA: several copies, one active leader (Lease). Every step is a plugin; a 2nd scheduler via spec.schedulerName.
